finding: The three literal Q-only relaxation witnesses in that checkpoint have a CRT lift to n=2310*2^k for k>=3, preserving all five old tails, one element per named odd-part class, and pairwise avoidance of old-head gcd classes {3,5,8,11}. Their odd residues modulo 1155 and anchor labels are the previous concrete witness residues; nonanchor residues modulo 2^(k+1) are their parity 0 or 1, while the five anchors use their literal residues 0,1,7,13,14. CRT gives a unique residue modulo n.
argument: For k>=3 the two-adic modulus is divisible by 16. Each nonanchor has mod16 coordinate 0 or 1; old anchors have mod16 coordinates 0,1,7,13,14. Equal-parity pairs differ by 0,2,6,12,14 modulo16, never 8; hence their gcd cannot be 8. Opposite-parity pairs have odd gcd, depending only on the preserved coordinates modulo 3,5,7,11; the concrete n=18480 controls already check the relevant odd-prime products are not 3,5,11. This is a Q-only relaxation, not a cyclic factorization or a code.
